title: Metabolite Extraction and Analysis Pipeline in China
summary: This cluster describes a metabolomics analysis pipeline in China, involving various processes and chemicals. Metabolite Extraction employs literature and equipment from Novogene Co. to process cell pellets and supernatant, producing a supernatant that is used to obtain methanol. Metabolomics analysis uses multiple platforms, including LC-MS/MS, to analyze fermentation solution samples. The pipeline involves centrifugation, biphasic protocol, and the use of chemicals such as ACN, ascorbic acid, and MeOH.
